technical.summary: Overbought momentum with strong volume spike and short-term bullish structure, but lacking intermediate trend confirmation and price below key moving averages; moderate risk/reward for swing entry.

fundamental.summary: KEY shows no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 51 days—insufficient fundamental or smart money support for conviction.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (12/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but weak congressional conviction and absent news data limit conviction; neutral composite signal.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (361) with flat yield curve and macro_score of -2 create severely unfavourable conditions; earnings in 51 days adds moderate event risk but does not mitigate acute volatility stress.

debate.key_bull_argument: Volume spike (15x), golden cross (SMA 9/21), bullish OBV, and extreme fear sentiment (12/100) create a contrarian setup with defined support at 16.1447 for risk management.
debate.key_bear_argument: Overbought momentum indicators, price below all intermediate moving averages (EMA 50, SMA 50), zero fundamental support, VIX crisis regime (361), and earnings event risk in 51 days overwhelm technical signals.

decision.entry_rationale: Volume spike and golden cross offer short-term technical structure, but overbought momentum combined with price below all intermediate moving averages signals weak entry quality in a crisis VIX regime.
decision.primary_risk: VIX crisis (361) and macro deterioration create severe volatility stress; earnings in 51 days add event risk that could gap position against support at 16.1447.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case dominance
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding KEY with 30 existing Financials positions (10% of portfolio); sector concentration and existing exposure reduce conviction further; skip entry to avoid compounding sector risk.
